task: troubleshoot a connector tool call failure

families.label: Entra app registration and connector scope list (third-party-admin, click-through)

variants.label: Add the missing Graph scope in both places and grant admin consent
steps: For a tool permission error or Graph 403, identify the scope the tool needs
Add the scope on the app registration and in the entry's scope list
Grant admin consent for the scope
For missing or failing write tools, add the matching write scope to the entry and consent it on the app registration
Upgrade Claude Desktop if the installed version predates write support

summary: Only third-party-inference Claude Desktop documents fixing M365 tool failures by adding and consenting missing Graph scopes.
